name: Branch Guard
description: Prevents direct mutations to protected branches (main, release/*). Intercepts git commit, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, am, pull, and push operations when the current HEAD is a protected branch, and writes an audit record for every violation and near-miss. Repos may be exempted via an explicit owner/repo allowlist (exempt_remotes) in the policy override file; there is no longer a blanket exemption for the guard's own home directory.
side_effects: blocks tool call with a permissionDecision: deny response (never a bare non-zero exit)
writes a violation audit record under $AI_ROOT/audit/violations/
writes a near-miss drift record under $AI_ROOT/audit/drift/ when applicable
platform_notes: Logic is cross-platform; inspects git command strings, which work identically on every OS. Live wiring is as a library: guard-dispatch.py imports check_invocation/load_policy/is_protected directly and is the actual PreToolUse entrypoint in practice. This script's own __main__ (invoked with the Claude tool payload on stdin) is a self-contained fallback for direct invocation. The command-wrapper invocation mode (previously wired via ~/.ai/bin/git) has been removed.
